title: Bɛrɛma Wa
subtitle: Bɛrɛma mɛ maa wa nɛ li
executiveLeadershipDescription: Bɛrɛma kpɔ wa nama lɛ, purogiramu, a yira yira kaa mɛ kpɔ.
leaderOneDescription: Sir Chamberline bɛrɛma nɛma kpɔ, ɔdun 20 nama lɛ, yira yira kaa a baraa vuɣi. MBA kpɔ, a yira yira o nyɔri o vuɣi.
leadershipTeamDescription: Yira yira o lɛ pia a kaa pia mɛ.
boardDescription: Boodi wa bɛrɛma, tata, a gɔmɛnɛ kpɔ.
advisoryDescription: Advaiza wa tɛknikali, mɛɛ, a bɛrɛma kpɔ.
ctaDescription: Wa vuura, mɛ, a baraa bara o li o kaa pia. Li Mɛ
